description: Department of Fiscal Policy - Order under Section 2 of the Casino Business (Regulation) Act No. 17 of 2010
categorisation: This gazette content contains an order made under the Casino Business (Regulation) Act, No. 17 of 2010, which establishes regulatory requirements for casino operations. It designates specific areas where casino business can be conducted and sets an effective date for the regulation. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it involves regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for business operations, specifically under existing legislation.
